Top-line acceleration signals demand strength, mainly in transportation services.
Profits grew but lagged revenue, implying margin pressure.
Growth positive, but below revenue growth, confirming mix/price pressure.
Compression tied to competitive pricing; watch if it stabilizes in H2.

This is a mid-cycle update showing continued revenue growth with some margin pressure. A clearer catalyst would be H2 evidence of margin recovery via route optimization and capacity utilization translating to stronger profitability.
